channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Abyss Kitchen
item.description: Abyss Kitchen is a survival action game in which you play the role of Lop a cook who accompanies a party of adventurers, and guides them with the power of food. Feed yourself in the dungeon and eat whatever you can to keep from starving and falling down. Eat up anything that stands in your way!

item.title: Limitless Survivor
item.description: Incremental roguelite with infinite progression. Collect powerful artifacts, gather crystals, and scale your stats to absurd levels. Let auto-play handle the grind anytime—even while you're away.

item.title: Mall Together
item.description: Run your mall. Open new stores, sign contracts with leading brands, hire teammates, and meet customer needs. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your mall.

item.title: Some of You May Die
item.description: Some of You May Die is a strategic autobattler where you can upgrade everything! Gather a team of heroes to embark on a singleplayer journey or go head to head with other players in online PvP!

item.title: Tormentum - Dark Sorrow
item.description: TORMENTUM is a dark Point & Click adventure game.The dreamlike, nightmarish atmosphere of the game was inspired by works of painters H.R. Giger and Zdzislaw Beksinski. The game's final look and feel was also strongly influenced by the universes of games such as Demon's Souls or Dark Seed.

item.title: Boba Cafe Simulator
item.description: You’re reborn—back at the beginning of your startup journey. In your last life, poor management led to your shop being crushed by competitors. This time, the sweet scent of condensed milk runs through your veins, and you’re set on one goal: turn “Sugarville” into the top name in the industry.

item.title: From The Ashes Expansion - Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™
item.description: Continue your adventure on Pandora with the From the Ashes expansion, inspired by the new Avatar: Fire and Ash film.

item.title: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom
item.description: Join the young king Evan as he sets out on an epic quest to found a new kingdom and, with the help of some new friends, unite his world, saving its people from a terrible evil.

item.title: Worlds Upon The Wind
item.description: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

item.title: 侠影录
item.description: "Legacy of Shadows" is a Wuxia roguelite. From avenging your fallen sect to unraveling the "Eternal Dragon" conspiracy, master fluid builds to cut through a world of intrigue and shatter the eternal scheme.

item.title: Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster
item.description: Baten Kaitos: Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean and Baten Kaitos Origins are now on Steam with improved graphics and new features to aid game progression, making them even easier to play!

item.title: CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic
item.description: Empire Club. The most luxurious bar that ladies and gentlemen come and gather. The beautiful maids who worked there danced and talked with the customers to amuse them.

item.title: EDENS ZERO
item.description: This is a 3D action role-playing game based on the space fantasy comic/anime EDENS ZERO by Hiro Mashima, creator of Fairy Tail and Rave Master. The player controls a diverse cast of characters as they embark on an epic adventure across different planets while battling powerful enemies!

item.title: Icarus: Creature Comforts Pack
item.description: This pack unlocks 20 new Husbandry items to craft, including luxury water troughs, covered food troughs, craftable saddles, and more

item.title: Icarus: Great Hunts Campaigns
item.description: The Great Hunts Campaigns introduce a new way to adventure in Icarus. Proceed down branching paths of decisions on your way to hunt down new Bosses. Your choices can affect the world around you, unlock unique, useful tools, or degrade the boss’s abilities

item.title: Icarus: Homestead Content Pack
item.description: This pack unlocks over 50 new Homestead themed items to craft, including interior and exterior decorations, new lighting options, themed variants of existing crafting and storage structures, farming and utility items and building pieces.

item.title: Icarus: Pet Companions Pack
item.description: This pack unlocks 15 new animals that you can have as tamed pets along with unique talent trees to have as companions as you survive on Icarus

item.title: Icarus: Styx Expansion
item.description: Centered around a wandering braided river, Styx has lain untouched for years by humans. Now, for the first time, prospectors can explore this new territory and tackle an array of new missions, in our first DLC the Styx Map & Missions Pack.

item.title: IRON REBELLION
item.description: Climb inside a colossal mech and take command from a fully interactive VR cockpit. Control every switch, weapon, and system, customize your mech, and face other pilots in tactical cross-platform multiplayer combat.

item.title: Parkasaurus
item.description: Parkasaurus is a dinosaur tycoon management simulation where you take care of your dinosaurs by constructing well-designed exhibits, researching specialized technologies, and maximizing profits to expand into the ultimate dinosaur theme park. Do you favor development for guests or your dinosaurs?

item.title: Shadows of Doubt
item.description: Take on the role of a private investigator in this immersive detective simulator. Solve murders and other crimes in a procedurally generated and persistent city where every NPC lives and breathes their own independent lives. Find the killer quickly… or they will kill again!

item.title: Wandering Sword
item.description: Wandering Sword is a Chinese martial-arts RPG where you play a young swordsman caught up in a feud and nearly dies. Escaping the event puts you on the path of pursuing the highest form of martial arts and exploring the pugilistic world to become the great hero you are always destined to be.

item.title: Yes, Your Grace
item.description: These are troubling times, Your Grace. The petitioners’ petty matters exceed our limited resources, to say nothing of the war. A careful balance must be struck. Your throne awaits.

item.title: Carnival Hunt
item.description: Carnival Hunt is a 5v1 first-person asymmetrical horror game. Five wind-up Bunnies must work together, manage their noisy keys, and find a way to escape an ever-changing carnival world while one player hunts them as the Carnival Monster.

item.title: Coin Tavern
item.description: Coin Tavern is not your average tavern! In this roguelike game, you’ll wield a wild array of quirky coins to build your one-of-a-kind coin deck. Hoard coins, refine strategies, streamline your deck, unlock hidden treasures, and land outrageous combos in randomized runs!

item.title: Dinoblade
item.description: Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.

item.title: Grim Dawn - Fangs of Asterkarn
item.description: Fangs of Asterkarn is our largest addition to the apocalyptic fantasy world of Grim Dawn, introducing players to the mighty Kurn tribes of Asterkarn as they contend with Ch'thonic corruption. Customize your potions, awaken the true power of Epic items, and enable the challenging new Ascendant mode.

item.title: High Times - Dating/Cooking Sim
item.description: Manage your own cafe and become a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Cook mood-changing donuts, decorate your shop, and help customers navigate life, love, and heartbreak—one bite at a time.

item.title: Icarus: New Frontiers Expansion
item.description: NEW FRONTIERS expands Icarus with a whole new map with hazardous environments, alien life and weather. Advance the story with six new chained narrative missions that delve into the mysteries of this alien planet. Extend your experience with 100+ new items to craft, collect, build, deploy and use.

item.title: Little Nightmares
item.description: Take on the role of Six, a lone child lost in a massive metal vessel known as the Maw, surrounded by dangerous, distorted versions of adults. You’ll need to do your best to escape in one piece or your fate will be worse than you ever dared dream.

item.title: Tormentum II
item.description: Wake up inside the nightmare world you created in this standalone, hand-drawn dark fantasy point-and-click adventure with psychological horror elements. Explore islands, solve puzzles, and make morally ambiguous choices that lead to multiple endings. Inspired by H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński.

item.title: WolfQuest: Anniversary Edition
item.description: Live the life of a wild wolf in a realistic ecological simulation set in Yellowstone National Park.

item.title: Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall
item.description: Rule your crumbling kingdom as you try to satisfy the petty needs of your people in this cinematic kingdom management RPG. Balance your resources, collect taxes, hire agents and make difficult decisions to see your kingdom prosper or fail.

item.title: Yet Another Zombie Defense HD
item.description: Top-down zombie shooter with tower defense elements featuring up to 4 players local and online co-op. Build your base by day, defend it by night, put your skills to the test to stay alive as long as possible! Darkness is coming. How long can YOU survive?

item.title: Turmoil
item.description: Drill for oil like it's 1899! Turmoil offers players a visually charming, tongue-in-cheek take on the simulation genre inspired by the 19th century oil rush in North America.

item.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu – Lost Explorers' Swords Pack
item.description: Enhance your armory with the Lost Explorers' Swords Pack and unlock two exclusive looks before heading out on expedition.
